public.title: Immer
public.description: input {base,recipe}; base is an object or array, recipe is an ordered list of {path,value} assignments with nonempty key/index paths and existing ancestor containers. Array indices must exist. Model produce by applying recipe to a mutable deep copy; return {base,next}. The supplied base must remain structurally unchanged. Recipe is data instead of a callback; structural sharing and proxy traps are not observable. Supported inputs are valid for this contract. Aggregate JSON-serialized input is at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, nesting depth at most 6, arrays at most 40 items, operation/call lists at most 20 items, and individual strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless a tighter bound is stated. Integers have absolute value at most 1000; output arithmetic stays within safe integers. String object keys and string path segments are nonempty safe alphanumeric/underscore names excluding __proto__, constructor and prototype. Empty arrays/objects are allowed where consistent with the contract. Output ordering follows the rules above. These bounds include all nested payloads and all operations together.
hints: Separate the documented JSON representation from the behavior being modeled.
Preserve ordering and distinguish missing values, null, zero and false carefully.

explanation: Deep-copy the base once and apply all recipe paths. O(base size plus recipe data and total path lengths) time and space; this does not test copy-on-write optimizations. Functional tests check the documented adapter behavior; they do not enforce implementation technique or prohibit built-in APIs.
